title: Jagged Steel (残钢) - Stats, Combo & How to Get
description: Jagged Steel (残钢) in Phantom Blade Zero - weapon class, slot, stats, combo contribution and how to obtain it, with unconfirmed numbers left marked as unconfirmed.
keyword: Jagged Steel (残钢) phantom blade zero

facts.label: How to obtain
facts.value: Weeping Creek Valley, Rustblade Pavilion bell

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Jagged Steel (残钢) is a one-handed blade in Phantom Blade Zero's primary weapon set. Slashes apply Bleeding, so its value is damage that keeps ticking after you disengage rather than burst on the swing.

sections.title: Weapon Class and Slot
sections.content: Jagged Steel (残钢) occupies the Primary slot, and it is classed as One-handed. Soul carries two primary blades and two secondary Phantom Edges at once, and switching between the four refills stamina rather than costing it - which is what keeps a combo chain running. Sha-chi is a separate pool, spent on heavy attacks and blocks. The full class lists are on the blade index.

sections.title: Stats and Effects
sections.content: Jagged Steel (残钢) has no published damage, scaling or speed figure, because the game does not print a numeric stat sheet for individual weapons. Nothing has been measured for this one either, so those three numbers are absent rather than estimated - the slot and the property are what the choice actually turns on.

sections.title: How It Plays
sections.content:
The reason to carry it is its property rather than a damage number: Slashes cause Bleeding.

Switching to it mid-combo refills stamina, so its practical job is to extend a chain past the point where the blade you were using runs dry. See the combat system for how the swap window works.

sections.title: How to Obtain
sections.content:
Weeping Creek Valley, Rustblade Pavilion bell.

Acquisition points are taken from the acquisition table on the weapons hub, which is kept in step with this page - if a route is corrected there, it is corrected here.

sections.title: Source Status
sections.content: This page records Jagged Steel (残钢) by slot, class and acquisition point, and by its property where one is published. Figures the game itself does not expose are left out. The system as a whole, with the full slot and class breakdown, is on the weapons list.
